verdict.rationale: Mailgun documents inbound email parsing via MX-pointed domains, route rules to forward/store parsed messages, and webhook/API delivery of events, plus community corroboration calling it the best inbound handling among competitors. missing for 10: no explicit documentation of full parsed payload structure (headers/body/attachments) in this evidence pack, and community notes inbound parsing is restricted on free tier and had DNS validation issues for some users.
